items.title: 56712_Cootie Williams oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee discusses Earl Hines' work with singers (Billy Eckstine, Sarah Vaughan, Herb Jeffries) but does not mention any direct personal or professional interaction with Earl Hines himself.

ctx.x: Is that so. Was Earl on those records? Was it those records? "Monday Date" and those early ones?
I think his wife was playing the piano on them.
